title: Hosts file
hint: Same format as /etc/hosts: IPv4 then hostname. One mapping per line. # starts a comment. IPv6 lines are ignored.
use_file_body: When off, this plugin clears its DNS overrides.
vpn_on: Protection is on. Hosts answers are live.
vpn_off: Start protection on the Home screen. Hosts only apply while the local VPN is up. This plugin does not start it.
page_desc: Classic /etc/hosts overlay for the local DNS engine.
